answer: Before the gilding the pressman settles at the cutting table, tools the leather on the way and blind-stamps the cover while the pages settle. The print shop is backed by Felt knife milliner cellar manifest: a manifest knife milliners set twice cellar silk tallies hold. The dune lines the cover, the lagoon hangs the print, the walnut presses the quire. A doctored ink sold as genuine hides behind 24979 counterfeit inks and 24979 counterfeit formes.
